title: Alien Portal on Mars
description: A soldier in green camouflage uniform and cap stands cautiously on cracked red desert terrain, looking toward an orange structure containing a glowing circular portal with purple and pink reflections. In the background, a small grey alien crouches on the structure's edge while a large red sun sets behind rocky mountains under a starry sky with multiple moons.
prompt: A realistic painting of a soldier in full camouflage uniform and cap standing on cracked red Martian desert, cautiously approaching an orange geometric structure with a glowing circular portal emitting purple and pink light. A small grey alien crouches on the edge of the structure. Dramatic red sunset behind rocky mountains, starry sky with several moons visible, rusty warning sign on the left. Surreal sci-fi atmosphere.
